title: Operator onboarding kit: RBAC v2, audit flows, and SSO recovery macros
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Purpose:
Provide a compact, on-call friendly onboarding kit for operators and support engineers that covers RBAC v2 admin flows, audit-log triage, and SSO/SAML recovery procedures. This ticket will produce three deliverables: (1) an operator runbook distilled for pager/context-free reads, (2) a one-page admin onboarding guide with screenshots and role mapping templates, and (3) a set of support macros and Slack templates for common RBAC/SSO/audit incidents.

Scope and non-goals:
- In scope: write clear step-by-step playbooks for: role escalation checks, permission debugging, verifying audit log integrity, SSO login failure triage (IdP metadata, SAML response decoding), and emergency admin unlocks. Include quick-check commands (CLI and Console) and safe rollback patterns.
- Out of scope: extending RBAC API surface or changing policy model. This ticket documents current v2 behavior and operational controls only.

Deliverables (expected):
- operator_runbook.md (short actionable steps + TL;DR checklists) hosted in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SecOps/RBAC+v2+Operator+Kit
- admin_onboarding_onepager.pdf (for new infra admins) stored in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/secure-admin-kits
- support_macros.json (Slack/GH issue templates + copy-paste macros) committed to repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-docs/pull/412

Key decisions and trade-offs so far:
- We intentionally keep macros concise and avoid embedding long log dumps to reduce noise. Full log ingestion links (secure short URLs) will be provided instead.
- For SSO recovery we include both Console and CLI steps; CLI steps require a privileged operator session and explicit audit log entry (to avoid silent bypasses).
- We recommend a 2-step admin unlock (operator action + audit annotation) rather than a one-click unlock to satisfy compliance teams — this is documented and justified in the runbook.

Acceptance criteria:
- Runbook reviewed by Security (Priya Sharma) and Support Lead (Ellen Morris).
- At least two runbook scenarios validated during an internal tabletop exercise with the on-call rotation.
- Support macros merged and tested in #support-testing channel.

Notes and references:
- Related incident postmortem (RBAC misconfiguration that surfaced audit gaps): https://incidents.redwood.ai/IR-2025-0421
- Design PR for RBAC v2 role mapping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design/pull/88
- Audit storage schema doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SecOps/Audit+Schema

Next steps:
1) Finish draft of operator_runbook.md (Carlos) — target 2026-03-16.
2) Run tabletop test scenario (Ellen) — schedule by 2026-03-20.
3) Iterate macros after feedback and land support_macros.json PR.
